name: ux-grandmaster
description: A design methodology for AI agents: frame the problem, research, design with your system, get an independent critique, prove accessibility, then hand off.

interface.longDescription: UX Grandmaster helps you design and review products the way a senior product designer would. It frames vague requests before designing, designs inside your design system and your platform's guidelines, finds UX and accessibility problems in your code with file and line, critiques designs with fresh eyes, and checks accessibility against WCAG 2.2 AA. It picks the right skill from your message and what you attach: a Figma link, a screenshot, code, interview notes or a CSV.
defaultPrompt: Design a money transfer screen for our banking app.
Check my app for UX and accessibility problems.
What did we learn from these interview notes?
